title: A Sigil for the Hollow
premise: In the valley of Hollowmere, where magic cannot cross the border stones, Freya Okonkwo copies prayers for a temple that stopped believing in answers generations ago. When the old gods suddenly begin replying—through his own handwriting—he learns the valley is a seal, and the debt he owes the temple is a leash meant to keep him inside it. To escape, Freya must find the Door of the Unwritten, hidden in a country that was erased from every map when the gods were bound. In the end, Freya opens the door but chooses to stay long enough to break the seal from within, freeing the valley at the cost of his own name being unwritten from memory.
about_author: Juniper Eastwick is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing abandoned parish records before turning to fiction. They write quiet, character-driven fantasy about ordinary people caught in the machinery of old bargains.

chapters.title: The Ink Answers Back
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. While transcribing a routine petition, Freya's pen moves without him, writing a reply in a dead god's hand. The temple elders confiscate the page and quietly double his debt. Emotional beat: wonder curdling into fear as Freya realizes his invisibility—the thing that kept him safe—is ending.

chapters.title: What the Border Stones Remember
chapters.summary: Freya's POV, with an interlude from the blind ferrywoman Sefa. Following the god's whispered clues, Freya visits the border stones and learns the valley is a prison built around one sealed door—and that his bloodline were its wardens. Emotional beat: loyalty to the temple fractures against the truth of what it has done.

chapters.title: A Country With No Name
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Hunted by temple wardens and guided by Sefa, Freya crosses into the erased country, where unwritten things survive: forgotten roads, unrecorded dead, and the Door of the Unwritten. The pursuing high priest offers him freedom in exchange for resealing it. Emotional beat: temptation of survival versus truth, at its sharpest.

chapters.title: The Price of Staying
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. At the door, Freya discovers opening it will flood the valley with raw magic—and destroy everyone who forgot how to live with it. He breaks the seal from within instead, letting the gods back gently, while his name unravels from every record and memory. Emotional beat: grief transformed into sacrifice; identity surrendered so others may keep theirs.
